clips.title: The story
paras: The long Trol'kalar chain reaches its last step. The light slowly fades, and Trol'kalar, held in a stone sheath, is released. Carry it to Zengu in Hammerfall.
At Trollbane's Tomb the light slowly fades, and Trol'kalar, kept in a stone sheath, is released. You take the sheathed sword to Zengu in Hammerfall, in the Arathi Highlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The light slowly fades, the sword Trol'kalar, held within a stone sheath has been released.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! Have you taken the sword?

clips.title: Completion
paras: For generations, the forces of Strom and Arathor ravaged the trolls. Now their greatest weapon is in our hands. Our inching progress in the steamy forests of Zul'Gurub will be no more.
Your assistance has been great, friend, and the Darkspear trolls are indebted to you.
I will be sure that the sword is delivered to Nimboya at Grom'gol.
